cards.body:
Parents call it a few minutes of peace. We call it purposeful play. 🙌

With movement that captures babies' attention, the Look At Me Ladybug encourages visual tracking and focus while supporting early development through play.
cards.title: The Looker Play Kit 🐞
cards.caption: lovevery.com
